# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.2 Worker 3: One-Shot AI Corridor Assignment, 1700-1836 Autonomy Yearly Pulse & Dev Page 93 Helpers (oe_col3_).
# Generated by gen_v122_col3_events_corridors.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Safe Variable Counter Helpers (Golden Rule #4: always initialize before change_variable)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Increment colonial crackdown heat safely.
oe_col3_inc_crackdown_heat = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_crackdown_heat } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_col3_crackdown_heat value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_col3_crackdown_heat add = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Decrement colonial crackdown heat safely (floored at 0).
oe_col3_dec_crackdown_heat = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_crackdown_heat } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_col3_crackdown_heat value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_col3_crackdown_heat
			var:oe_col3_crackdown_heat >= 1
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_col3_crackdown_heat subtract = 1 }
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Upgrade 5: Era-Aware AI Corridor Seeding & Vanilla Africa-Pref Pruning at on_game_start
# ==============================================================================
oe_col3_assign_ai_corridors = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_col3_corridors_seeded } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_col3_corridors_seeded value = 1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes is_rebel_country = no }
			# Prune vanilla explore_african_coast leak on pre-1415, New World, East/Inner Asian, or landlocked AI
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_area_preference = explore_african_coast
					OR = {
						current_year < 1415
						has_ports = no
						capital ?= { continent = continent:america }
						capital ?= {
							OR = {
								sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
								region = region:mongolia_region
								region = region:steppes_region
								region = region:tibet_region
								region = region:xinjiang_region
							}
						}
					}
				}
				remove_area_preference = explore_african_coast
			}
			# Qing / Manchu (MCH or post-1644 / Manchu-formed CHI): Inner Asia corridor + anti-Africa guard
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						tag = MCH
						AND = {
							tag = CHI
							OR = {
								current_year >= 1644
								has_or_had_tag = MCH
							}
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_qing_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_nanyang_nurgan_corridor }
					remove_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_nanyang_nurgan_corridor
				}
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_qing_inner_asia_corridor
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_avoid_africa
			}
			# Ming / Pre-1644 Celestial Empire (1368-1643): Nanyang & Nurgan corridor + anti-Africa guard
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1368
					current_year < 1644
					OR = {
						tag = MNG
						AND = {
							tag = CHI
							NOT = { has_or_had_tag = MCH }
						}
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_cel_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_nanyang_nurgan_corridor
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_avoid_africa
			}
			# Edo Japan (JAP, 1635-1853 Sakoku Era): homeland archipelago guard focus
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = JAP
					current_year >= 1635
					current_year <= 1853
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_jap_sakoku_assigned value = 1 }
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_japan_sakoku_focus
			}
			# European overseas exploration corridors (strictly gated >= 1450; 1337 receives them at 1450 via yearly tick)
			if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1450 }
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { tag = ENG tag = GBR } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_col3_gbr_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
					add_area_preference = oe_col3_eng_north_america_india_corridor
				}
				if = {
					limit = { tag = FRA }
					set_variable = { name = oe_col3_fra_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
					add_area_preference = oe_col3_fra_st_lawrence_louisiana_corridor
				}
				if = {
					limit = { tag = NED }
					set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ned_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
					add_area_preference = oe_col3_ned_cape_spice_corridor
				}
				if = {
					limit = { tag = POR }
					set_variable = { name = oe_col3_por_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
					add_area_preference = oe_col3_por_brazil_goa_macau_corridor
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Lightweight Yearly Pulse (called from Stage oe_v122_pulse.txt)
# 0) One-shot per-country prune of vanilla explore_african_coast leak.
# 1) Late-unlock Russia Far East corridor once Ostrog built or 1580+ reached.
# 2) Era-aware Qing vs Ming Celestial corridor seeding & swap.
# 3) Post-1450 dynamic European overseas exploration corridors (ENG/GBR, FRA, NED, POR).
# 4) Dispatch 1700-1836 Colonial Autonomy & Independence Wave events (10-year CD).
# ==============================================================================
oe_col3_yearly_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_rebel_country = no num_locations > 0 }
		# 0. One-shot cleanup of vanilla explore_african_coast leak (runs once per AI country).
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_africa_pref_pruned }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_col3_africa_pref_pruned value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_area_preference = explore_african_coast
					OR = {
						current_year < 1415
						has_ports = no
						capital ?= { continent = continent:america }
						capital ?= {
							OR = {
								sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
								region = region:mongolia_region
								region = region:steppes_region
								region = region:tibet_region
								region = region:xinjiang_region
							}
						}
					}
				}
				remove_area_preference = explore_african_coast
			}
		}
		# 1. Dynamic one-shot Russia Siberia->Pacific->Alaska unlock once Ostrog / 1580 active.
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				OR = { tag = MOS tag = RUS }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_rus_fareast_assigned }
				OR = {
					current_year >= 1580
					any_owned_location = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_col2_cossack_ostrog }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_col3_rus_fareast_assigned value = 1 }
			add_area_preference = oe_col3_russia_far_east_corridor
		}
		# 2a. Qing / Manchu (MCH or post-1644 / Manchu-formed CHI): Inner Asia corridor & prune Ming Nanyang corridor.
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				OR = {
					tag = MCH
					AND = {
						tag = CHI
						OR = {
							current_year >= 1644
							has_or_had_tag = MCH
						}
					}
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_qing_corridor_assigned }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_col3_qing_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_nanyang_nurgan_corridor }
				remove_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_nanyang_nurgan_corridor
			}
			add_area_preference = oe_col3_qing_inner_asia_corridor
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_avoid_africa } }
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_avoid_africa
			}
		}
		# 2b. Ming / Pre-1644 Celestial Empire (1368-1643): Nanyang & Nurgan corridor.
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				current_year >= 1368
				current_year < 1644
				OR = {
					tag = MNG
					AND = {
						tag = CHI
						NOT = { has_or_had_tag = MCH }
					}
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_cel_corridor_assigned }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_col3_cel_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
			add_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_nanyang_nurgan_corridor
			add_area_preference = oe_col3_celestial_avoid_africa
		}
		# 2c. Edo Japan (JAP, 1635-1853 Sakoku Era): homeland archipelago guard focus; lift after 1853.
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				tag = JAP
				current_year >= 1635
				current_year <= 1853
				NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_col3_japan_sakoku_focus }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_col3_jap_sakoku_assigned value = 1 }
			add_area_preference = oe_col3_japan_sakoku_focus
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				tag = JAP
				current_year > 1853
				has_area_preference = oe_col3_japan_sakoku_focus
			}
			remove_area_preference = oe_col3_japan_sakoku_focus
		}
		# 3. Dynamic one-shot European overseas exploration corridors once 1450+ reached.
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				current_year >= 1450
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = { tag = ENG tag = GBR }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_gbr_corridor_assigned }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_gbr_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_eng_north_america_india_corridor
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = FRA
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_fra_corridor_assigned }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_fra_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_fra_st_lawrence_louisiana_corridor
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = NED
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ned_corridor_assigned }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ned_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_ned_cape_spice_corridor
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = POR
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_por_corridor_assigned }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_por_corridor_assigned value = 1 }
				add_area_preference = oe_col3_por_brazil_goa_macau_corridor
			}
		}
		# 4. 1700-1836 Colonial Autonomy & Independence Arc (throttled: 10-year cooldown).
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_col3_eligible_autonomy_arc = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_autonomy_cd }
				NOT = { var:oe_col3_federation_enacted ?= 1 }
			}
			oe_col3_ensure_init = yes
			set_variable = { name = oe_col3_autonomy_cd years = 10 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_col3_autonomy_stage ?= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_autonomy_stage value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.5
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_col3_autonomy_stage ?= 1
					has_variable = oe_col3_crackdown_heat
					var:oe_col3_crackdown_heat >= 1
					current_year >= 1715
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_autonomy_stage value = 2 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.6
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = { var:oe_col3_autonomy_stage ?= 1 var:oe_col3_autonomy_stage ?= 2 }
					current_year >= 1720
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ev7_seen }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev7_seen value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_autonomy_stage value = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.7
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = oe_col3_crackdown_heat
					var:oe_col3_crackdown_heat >= 2
					current_year >= 1735
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ev9_seen }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev9_seen value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.9
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = oe_col3_crackdown_heat
					var:oe_col3_crackdown_heat >= 2
					current_year >= 1750
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ev10_seen }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev10_seen value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = oe_col3_crackdown_heat
					var:oe_col3_crackdown_heat >= 3
					current_year >= 1765
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ev11_seen }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev11_seen value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.11
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1785
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_col3_ev12_seen }
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_col3_post_imperial_trade_pact_mod }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_col3_ev12_seen value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.12
			}
		}
	}
}

# Dev Page 93 (oe_dev.93) Event & Corridor Verification Helpers (2618-2631, CMDLOG=0)

# 2618: Single-step Colonization 3.0 yearly pulse (clears 10-year autonomy cooldown first for immediate test).
oe_col3_dev_yearly_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_col3_autonomy_cd }
		remove_variable = oe_col3_autonomy_cd
	}
	oe_col3_yearly_tick = yes
}

# 2619: Open Colonization 3.0 read-only audit ledger (oe_col3.90).
oe_col3_dev_open_readout = {
	oe_col3_ensure_init = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.90
}

# 2622: Seed v11.5 Cartaz global flag and trigger Defying the Portuguese Cartaz (oe_col3.3).
oe_col3_dev_ev3_cartaz = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_por_cartaz_active value = 1 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.3
}

# 2623: Apply v12.5 Letters of Marque modifier and trigger Scourge of Ocean Privateers (oe_col3.4).
oe_col3_dev_ev4_marque = {
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_nav2_letters_of_marque_active
		years = 5
		mode = replace
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col3.4
}
